assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official redline and official key-area polygons are not yet published; all submitted geometry uses repository provisional rough boundaries and must be recomputed when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive metrics, land-use partition, phasing and figures are provisional and subject to full recalculation.
assumptions.trigger: Official SITE_BOUNDARY / KEY_AREA GeoJSON published in brief/site-package/geometry/

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are simplified conceptual clusters for design communication only, not survey, ownership or statutory data.
assumptions.impact: Building density is indicative; statutory FAR/height/density require approved regulatory planning conditions.
assumptions.trigger: Official parcel, ownership and regulatory planning data available

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines are structural suggestions; road redlines, rail alignments, municipal utilities and fire/engineering conditions remain to be confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Traffic and municipal conclusions are design discussion only.
assumptions.trigger: Official road redline and municipal engineering data

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios, pilgrimage landmarks, event systems and operation mechanisms are conceptual suggestions or material for professional teams to deepen; they are not statutory planning, government commitment or confirmed implementation.
assumptions.impact: No implementation promise is implied by scenario cards or operation plan.
